# InfronixWeb

> A digital agency in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India helping businesses build, grow, market and automate their digital presence through web development, SEO, digital marketing, paid advertising and AI-powered automation.

## Services

- [services](https://www.infronixweb.in/services) — Overview of all digital services offered by InfronixWeb.
- [web development](https://www.infronixweb.in/web-development) — Modern, responsive, fast and conversion-focused websites for businesses, service providers, brands and companies.
- [seo](https://www.infronixweb.in/seo) — Search engine optimization services focused on improving organic visibility, rankings, local reach and relevant website traffic.
- [digital marketing](https://www.infronixweb.in/digital-marketing) — Digital marketing strategies focused on online visibility, lead generation, customer acquisition and business growth.
- [social media marketing](https://www.infronixweb.in/digital-marketing/social-media-marketing) — Social media strategy, content planning, audience growth, brand awareness and lead generation.
- [google ads](https://www.infronixweb.in/google-ads) — Google Ads campaign setup, keyword targeting, optimization and lead generation for businesses.
- [meta ads](https://www.infronixweb.in/meta-ads) — Facebook and Instagram advertising focused on awareness, leads, conversions, retargeting and customer acquisition.
- [performance marketing](https://www.infronixweb.in/performance-marketing) — Data-driven marketing focused on measurable outcomes such as leads, conversions and customer acquisition.
- [ai automation](https://www.infronixweb.in/ai-automation) — AI-powered business automation for reducing repetitive work and improving operational efficiency.
- [ai chatbot](https://www.infronixweb.in/ai-chatbot) — AI chatbot solutions for customer support, lead qualification, FAQs and automated website conversations.
- [whatsapp automation](https://www.infronixweb.in/whatsapp-automation) — WhatsApp automation for customer communication, lead follow-ups, support, notifications and engagement.
- [crm automation](https://www.infronixweb.in/crm-automation) — CRM workflow automation for lead management, follow-ups, sales pipelines, customer communication and internal processes.
